patterns.name: private-key
patterns.description: PEM, OpenSSH and PGP private key blocks; an unterminated block is redacted to the end of the text.
patterns.regex: -----BEGIN[ A-Z0-9]*PRIVATE KEY(?: BLOCK)?-----(?:[\s\S]*?-----END[ A-Z0-9]*PRIVATE KEY(?: BLOCK)?-----|[\s\S]*)

patterns.name: jwt
patterns.description: JSON Web Tokens (three base64url parts, the first two starting with eyJ).

patterns.name: github-token
patterns.description: GitHub personal access, OAuth, app and refresh tokens, classic and fine-grained.

patterns.name: slack-token
patterns.description: Slack bot, user, app and refresh tokens.

patterns.name: google-api-key
patterns.description: Google API keys, including Gemini API keys.

patterns.name: openai-api-key
patterns.description: OpenAI API keys (sk-, sk-proj-, sk-svcacct-, sk-admin-) containing at least one digit.

patterns.name: connection-string
patterns.description: Passwords and account keys in connection strings (Password=, Pwd=, AccountKey=, SharedAccessKey= after a ';') and in URLs (scheme://user:password@host).

patterns.name: env-assignment
patterns.description: Upper-case environment-style assignments at the start of a line, such as DB_PASSWORD=..., API_KEY=... or export GITHUB_TOKEN=...; the value is redacted, the name kept.

patterns.name: secret-assignment
patterns.description: Assignments to names ending in password, passwd, passphrase, secret, token, api_key, access_key, private_key or secret_key, with = or :. Quoted values of 4 or more characters are redacted; unquoted values only when they have 6 or more characters including a digit or symbol, so that code such as password = getPassword() or self.password = password is left alone.
